# build/agent3/gameplay/gameplay-route.txt - M3 gameplay task. Generated by gen_gameplay_route.py: do not edit by hand.
# Both-arms route: the EXPLORE2 marker-gated boot (title gate) -> New Game -> slot 1 -> the story, the 3 figure
# prompts (prompt sidecar), 60 s observe, the A/START-A skip probes, then ~4 min of walk/fight cycles (marks
# wNN-a/b). -Seconds 1500 per arm (a cap: the route's 'stop' ends it).
# Needs the toypad sidecar (gameplay-run.ps1 starts it: the virtual Batman/Gandalf/Wyldstyle tags 2 s after the
# front end's all-pads-white line; 'mark v-replace' = REMOVE + re-LOAD them). Every 'mark' = one screenshot.
wait_first_frame 240
mark first-frame
wait_log "current=7 pending=4294967295" 120                    # install prompt
sleep 2
mark install-prompt
press A                                         # -> all pads white; the sidecar places the tags 2 s later
wait_log "Toypad: pad 3 mode 1 lit FF FF FF" 25
mark pads-white
wait_log "Toypad listener: LOAD -> pad=3" 20
mark tags-placed
sleep 2
press A
wait_log "current=0 pending=4294967295" 6
press A
wait_log "current=0 pending=4294967295" 6
press A
wait_log "current=0 pending=4294967295" 6
press A
wait_log "current=0 pending=4294967295" 6
press A
wait_log "current=0 pending=4294967295" 6
press A
wait_log "current=0 pending=4294967295" 6
mark intro-start
sleep 20
mark intro-20
wait_log "current=12 pending=4294967295" 420                  # title 'Press START' (the intro ends by itself)
sleep 3
mark title
sleep 12                                        # title gate: settle (START at +3.8 s was ignored)
press START                                     # title gate try 1/6
wait_log "current=13 pending=4294967295" 10
press START                                     # title gate try 2/6
wait_log "current=13 pending=4294967295" 10
press START                                     # title gate try 3/6
wait_log "current=13 pending=4294967295" 10
press START                                     # title gate try 4/6
wait_log "current=13 pending=4294967295" 10
press START                                     # title gate try 5/6
wait_log "current=13 pending=4294967295" 10
press START                                     # title gate try 6/6
wait_log "current=13 pending=4294967295" 10
sleep 2
mark press-start
press B                                         # converge: 13 -> Updates panel; nothing if already there
sleep 4
mark updates-panel
press A                                         # -> the Store notice (5 -> 0)
wait_log "current=5 pending=0" 20               # TITLE GATE CHECK: TIMEOUT = the title never took START
sleep 3
mark store-notice
press A                                         # OK
sleep 3
press B
wait_log "current=17 pending=4294967295" 20                  # main menu
sleep 2
mark main-menu
stick L 30000 0 250                             # Credits -> New Game (one short tap)
sleep 1.5
mark menu-newgame
press A
wait_log "current=47 pending=4294967295" 15                  # New Game: save slots
sleep 3
mark ng-slots
press A                                         # slot 1
wait_log "current=49 pending=4294967295" 15                  # Confirm (default Yes)
sleep 3
mark ng-confirm
press A
wait_log "current=54 pending=4294967295" 20                  # autosave notice (52 -> 53 -> 54)
sleep 3
mark ng-autosave
press A

sleep 3
mark ng-toypad
press A
wait_log "current=55 pending=0" 15              # -> the story (front end 0 from here)
sleep 3
mark story-00
# --- S: the story's figure prompts (manual run: pad 2 Batman, pad 3 Gandalf, pad 1 Wyldstyle; 120 s each) ---
wait_log "Toypad listener: LOAD -> pad=2" 240
mark s-batman                                 # the sidecar answered (or the wait timed out)
sleep 10
mark s-batman-10

mark s-gandalf                                 # the sidecar answered (or the wait timed out)
sleep 10

# --- O: observe, no input ---

mark o-01
